data.purpose: Provide a benchmark random‑forest probability‑of‑default (PD) model to challenge the champion model CR‑001.
data.data: Uses the German credit dataset (german_final_v3.csv) as input and reads champion scores from cr001_scores.csv. Model outputs variable importance to cr002_importance.csv.
data.methodology: Implements a random‑forest classifier using the ranger library.
data.variables: All variables from the German credit dataset after removing the original creditability target; the target variable is binary bad (1) vs good (0).
data.implementation: Implemented in R (cr002_rf.R) that reads the data, trains a ranger model, generates PD predictions, computes correlation with champion scores, saves the model (cr002_rf.rds) and variable importance (cr002_importance.csv).
data.assumptions_limitations: Assumes the German credit extract is representative; hard‑coded file paths limit portability; development and validation data are not version‑controlled; validation was deferred.
data.monitoring: No ongoing monitoring plan or performance thresholds are documented.
data.gaps: Hardcoded file paths: production data source is not documented or controlled.; No ongoing‑monitoring plan or thresholds documented.; Development and validation data not available in repository; validation deferred.
